seed_mapping: Existing validation seeds initialize three independent adaptation environment streams. Only first reset is seeded; later resets advance that stream. Calibration seeds remain reserved for physical calibration. No new seeds or severities selected.
persistence: Predictor, Adam, replay and global decision counter persist across the three episodes of one condition/method/stream. Physics schedule and planner warm start reset each episode. All learned state resets to 750k for each new run.
snapshot_semantics: After transition and permitted updates; at episode end, after episode-wise updates. Evaluation-only snapshots, not exact mid-episode continuation.
